_comment: The gateway mapping that puts `lookup-resolve` on a URL the browser can POST to.
Not a flow definition -- build-flows.mjs loads flows by explicit name, so this file is
inert to it. It is the reproducible record of the three API calls that made the route,
because there is no other place in this repo that records a mapping.
One mapping serves EVERY lookup kind. The kind is a body field, not a path, so adding a
kind is an edit to contract artefact 7's table -- not a new flow and not a new route.
The mapping lives on the ACCOUNT's own gateway, never on api.microstrate.io: a tenant
cannot write to the platform gateway. Find the id with `GET /gateway/all`; on
Three calls, in order. ALL THREE ARE REQUIRED -- see `traps`.
Values below were read back from the live mapping on 2026-09-02, not composed.

mapping_version.description: Lookup resolver for the quote form (contract artefact 7)

traps: Step 3 is NOT optional and its absence is a 500 with an EMPTY BODY. POST /mapping never
sets traffic_distribution, and cerberus skips every version whose weight is 0, so the
route mounts with an empty version list and dies in the recoverer. Nothing says 'no version'.
A correct mapping can serve plain-text `404 page not found` for MINUTES -- the per-gateway
route table is stale, not the mapping. `bcli publish ms.gateway.<id>.reload` cannot reach a
sub-account. Over HTTP: PATCH /gateway/<id> with any harmless field (a description). That
writes ms.gateway.<id>.gateway, which cerberus turns into a per-gateway rebuild, and the
route serves on the next request.
is_public false means a version with no authorization middleware gets DenyClientAuthorizer.
A user on the `client` role is refused this route until one is attached.
Mappings CANNOT be removed over HTTP: DELETE /mapping, PATCH /mapping/version and
DELETE /mapping/version all 405 on a tenant gateway. A route, once made, is permanent.
Revoking the key is the only lever.
